title: Capitals of the Americas Quiz: 20 Questions
description: How well do you know the capitals of Latin America and the Caribbean? Take this 20-question quiz, from Mexico City to Nassau. Free and quick.
h1: Capitals of the Americas Quiz: From Mexico to Patagonia
intro: From the Andes to the Caribbean islands, the Americas are packed with fascinating capitals. This quiz covers 20 of them across Mexico, Central America, South America and the Caribbean. You will start with big names like Mexico City, Buenos Aires and Lima, then work through the smaller countries of Central America, and finish with some trickier Caribbean and Guianan capitals. You have about five seconds for each question, so rely on your instincts. After every answer, a short explanation gives you a fact about the city. Whether you are planning a trip or just curious, see how many capitals you can get right.

questions.q: What is the capital of Mexico?
questions.explication: Mexico City was built on top of the Aztec capital, Tenochtitlan, and is one of the largest cities in the world.

questions.q: What is the capital of Argentina?
questions.explication: Buenos Aires sits on the Río de la Plata and is famous as the birthplace of the tango.

questions.q: What is the capital of Peru?
questions.explication: Lima, founded by Francisco Pizarro in 1535, is on the Pacific coast. Cusco was the Inca capital.

questions.q: What is the capital of Chile?
questions.explication: Santiago lies in a valley with the Andes in view. Valparaíso, the port city, is home to Chile's Congress.

questions.q: What is the capital of Colombia?
questions.explication: Bogotá sits high in the Andes, at about 8,660 feet above sea level.

questions.q: What is the capital of Cuba?
questions.explication: Havana is the largest city in the Caribbean, famous for its old town and vintage American cars.

questions.q: What is the capital of Venezuela?
questions.explication: Caracas lies in a valley near the Caribbean coast and is Venezuela's largest city.

questions.q: What is the capital of Uruguay?
questions.explication: Montevideo is home to roughly 40 percent of Uruguay's population.

questions.q: What is the capital of Paraguay?
questions.explication: Asunción, founded in 1537 on the Paraguay River, is one of the oldest cities in South America.

questions.q: What is the capital of Panama?
questions.explication: Panama City sits at the Pacific entrance of the Panama Canal.

questions.q: What is the capital of Costa Rica?
questions.explication: San José became the capital in 1823. Cartago was the capital during the colonial period.

questions.q: What is the capital of Honduras?
questions.explication: Tegucigalpa is in a mountain valley. San Pedro Sula is the country's industrial center.

questions.q: What is the capital of Nicaragua?
questions.explication: Managua lies on the shore of Lake Managua. León and Granada were historic rivals for the capital.

questions.q: What is the capital of Haiti?
questions.explication: Port-au-Prince lies on the Gulf of Gonâve, on the western side of Hispaniola.

questions.q: What is the capital of the Dominican Republic?
questions.explication: Santo Domingo, founded in 1496, is the oldest continuously inhabited European settlement in the Americas.

questions.q: What is the capital of El Salvador?
questions.explication: San Salvador sits at the foot of a volcano and is the country's political and economic center.

questions.q: What is the capital of Guyana?
questions.explication: Georgetown lies at the mouth of the Demerara River and is known for its wooden colonial architecture.

questions.q: What is the capital of Suriname?
questions.explication: Paramaribo has a historic inner city that is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.q: What is the capital of Jamaica?
questions.explication: Kingston is the heart of Jamaica's music scene and the cradle of reggae.

questions.q: What is the capital of the Bahamas?
questions.explication: Nassau is on New Providence Island, and it is home to most of the country's population.

faq: What is the capital of Brazil?

Brasília is the capital of Brazil, not Rio de Janeiro or São Paulo. It was built from scratch in the late 1950s and became the capital in 1960. Brazil is in South America, but this quiz focuses on countries from Mexico southward and the Caribbean.
Which countries are included in this quiz?
The quiz covers capitals in Mexico, Central America, South America and the Caribbean. It does not include the United States or Canada. Try our world capitals quiz next if you want a broader test.
What is the highest capital city in the Americas?

La Paz, Bolivia, is the highest seat of government in the world at about 11,900 feet above sea level. Bolivia has two capitals: Sucre is the constitutional capital, and La Paz is the seat of government. Quito, Ecuador, is also very high.
